content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Round Rock

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years of equivalent experience. Review PMI's full eligibility criteria now to confirm you meet the education and documented project-hours threshold before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy delivers live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp training nationwide. Attend scheduled sessions from your Round Rock location on your own schedule. Our active certified practitioners cover the full PMBOK® framework, exam domains, and real-world application across technology, healthcare, manufacturing, and logistics sectors.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing bootcamp coursework, submit your formal PMP application directly to PMI with proof of your contact hours and project experience. Pay PMI's examination fee at application. Granite PM Academy staff can clarify documentation requirements and answer questions about the submission process.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides exam-preparation resources, practice tests, and study guidance as part of bootcamp completion. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner. You'll have multiple windows to test; prepare at your own pace and test when confident.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP® credential is valid for three years. Maintain it by earning professional development units (PDUs) through project management education, conferences, and volunteer work. PMI's flexible renewal options let you stay current while advancing your career in Round Rock's dynamic project-driven sectors.
